column1: # Magpie plugin catalog. One row per community plugin the deployment pins.
# name     the plugin's short name, as `magpie plugin on|off` takes it.
# source   the npm package the plugin is installed from. The plugin is
#          community-owned: the deployment pins and installs it, and never
# version  the exact version the deployment pins. `latest` is not a pin.
# enabled  yes when the deployment ensures the plugin is installed and on,
#          no when the row is parked.
